Description:
[size=5][b]Largely Inspired by my childhood <3 the grocery store shopping carts and also somewhat inspired by Hamtaro, Drawn too Life from the DS and Doraemon[/b][/size]

[size=5][b]Please note the customization for the car isnt perfect, i am going to tweak and update it soon, as well as the dialogue for Pierre referencing the car. I really hope you like my mod! keep me posted okay!

[/b][/size]
[size=5][b]Pierre's Miniature Car Mod[/b][/size]
[size=5] For years, a mysterious miniature red-and-yellow toy car has been sitting in Pierre's back room gathering dust. Nobody knows where he got it—maybe a shady traveling merchant, maybe a garage sale in Zuzu City—and Pierre is [i]desperate[/i] to get it out of his closet. Walk into Pierre's General Store and talk to him, and he'll swear up and down it's worth [b]15,000g[/b]... before offering his "favorite customer" a special [b]5,000g[/b] deal just to finally get rid of it. [i](No refunds!)[/i]
Hop in, zoom across Pelican Town, blast your turbo, customize it with a full color wheel and patterns, and just try not to abandon it in Mayor Lewis's house for two days—or Pierre will come calling with a tow bill.

Also your probably wondering, why didn't i add the Car cart too Jojo Mart, BECAUSE NO >:(  we dont need that stain on our beautiful car![/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=5][b]Buy from Pierre ([/b][/size]

[code]5,000g[/code][size=5][b]):[/b] Talk to Pierre inside his General Store (or check his shop counter / click the display car) to hear his sales pitch and buy your own Miniature Cozy Car.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Sitting Driver & See-Through Windshield:[/b] Your farmer sits right inside the cab facing the direction you drive, visible through the open side windows and shiny tinted front windshield.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Turbo Boost ([/b][/size]

[code]Shift[/code][size=5][b]):[/b] Hold [b]Shift[/b] while driving to kick into turbo speed with roaring turbo audio, revved motor sounds, billowing exhaust smoke, and sparks![/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Real Nighttime Headlights & Glowing Taillights ([/b][/size]

[code]H[/code][size=5][b]):[/b] Toggle headlights and glowing ruby-red taillights on or off anytime (or let them switch on automatically at dusk) to genuinely light up dark roads at night.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Silly Custom Sounds & Dynamic Terrain Audio:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=5]Car door open & close sounds when hopping in and out.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]4 Selectable Horns:[/b] Clown Nose Honk, Bike Horn, Mini Car Horn, and Bike Bell.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Dynamic Road Sounds & Particles:[/b] Distinct tire sounds and particles for [b]dirt paths[/b], [b]grass[/b], [b]cobblestone[/b], [b]pavement / wood[/b], and [b]sand[/b].[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Park Anywhere + 2-Day Tow Impound:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=5]Park anywhere in Stardew Valley—even right inside someone's house (no driving indoors, though—interact with it to roll it back outside!). Your car's exact spot is saved across days.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Parking outside on [b]your Farm[/b] is safe forever. Leave it abandoned anywhere else in the valley for [b]2 days[/b], and Pierre will drag it back outside his shop and charge a [b]250g tow fee[/b] to give you your keys back![/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=5][b]Pierre's Paint & Design Studio ([/b][/size]

[code]100g[/code][size=5][b]):[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=5]After buying the car, talk to Pierre (or click [b]Cozy Car Paint Studio[/b] at his counter) to customize your ride for [b]100g[/b]![/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Includes a live 4-direction spinning preview, an interactive [b]HSV Color Wheel + Brightness Slider[/b], [b]5 paintable parts[/b] ([i]Body, Roof, Pattern, Antenna, Rims[/i]), [b]9 patterns[/b] ([i]None, Stripes, Polka Dots, Checkers, Flames, Cow Print, Stars, Hearts, Rainbow[/i]), and 1-click theme presets.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]

Manifest.Name: Cozy Car
Manifest.Description: Buy a silly miniature Cozy Car from Pierre, drive around Stardew Valley with headlights, dirt puffs, surface sounds, selectable honks, a lip-flapping motor, and persistent parking (just don't leave it abandoned for 2 days or Pierre will tow it!).
Manifest.Author: Thomas
